<cite ref="Bava Metzia 104b:5">B. Mets. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>אי מקנא לא מִיכְּפֵל</he> if formal obligation is to be entered into (v. <cite ref="S01587"><he>קִנְיָן</he></cite>), the document must not be made out for double the amount, v. <cite ref="K01026">preced.</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shabbat 5a:12">Sabb. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>איכ׳ תנא וכ׳</he> was it necessary for the Tannai to take pains to let us hear all this (to be so explicit)?—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 46a">B. Mets. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>וא׳ תנא וכ׳</he> should the Tannai have taken the trouble to speak of such an exceptional case as that of a naked man &c.?—
B. Bath. 91ᵃ אִיכְּפֵל ואוליד וכ׳ apply thyself (Rashi: marry again), and beget &c.

<cite ref="Shevuot 48b:4">Shebu. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>אִיכְפְּלִי ואתאי וכ׳</he> have I taken the trouble to come all this distance for the sake of upsetting &c.?; a. e.—[Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ top <he>אכפלן</he> ed. Zyt., v. <cite ref="A02728"><he>אֲפַךְ</he></cite>.]
